analyst.summary: Aptus Value Housing Finance lends to self-employed, lower-income families buying their first home in semi-urban and rural South India - a genuine, underserved growth market. Asset quality is healthy (bad-loan ratios around 1-1.5%), margins are stable, and profit continues to grow at a healthy double-digit pace. The sharp-looking drop in 'promoter' holding is largely the company's founding private-equity sponsors gradually selling down their stake after the 2021 listing, a normal pattern for this kind of IPO, and institutional investors have been steady buyers as that has happened. At a modest ~16 times earnings for a well-run, healthy-asset-quality lender, this looks like a reasonably attractively priced Hold.
